overview_description.description: Urban provides a marketplace for freelance labor. It offers a variety of home services to consumers, including beauty treatments, haircuts, deep cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, and appliance repairs. The platform helps customers book reliable home services and it aims to help millions of service professionals across the world to deliver services at home. The company partners with tens of thousands of service professionals, helping them with training, credit, product procurement, insurance, and technology.

press_references.value: Gig Workers’ Welfare Prog: Karnataka To Put Out Draft Rules In 2 Weeks
